description: Publications::artifacts() now also reads self.staged, so an uncommitted publication could reach ResultEnvelope.artifacts

system.source:
pub fn artifacts(&self, task: &TaskHandle) -> Result<Vec<ArtifactRef>, Fault> {
        self.committed
            .iter()
            .chain(self.staged.iter())
            .map(|publication| publication.artifact(task))
            .collect()
    }
